name: pantheon
description: Makes Claude an orchestrator that delegates to specialist roles on Codex or native Claude agents, chosen per profile, with an auto-opening /pantheon panel for roles, activity and a session log, and a strip above the prompt with model, context, cache, rate limits and running agents.

profile.title: Active profile
profile.description: Picks the active Pantheon profile. Overrides the profile set in ~/.claude/pantheon.json or <repo>/.claude/pantheon.json; when unset, those files decide (default claude). Custom profiles defined in those files are accepted.

abovePrompt.title: Strip above the prompt
abovePrompt.description: Shows the info, usage and limits rows above the prompt, plus a summary of the roles running now. Turn it off to hide the strip.

paceStart.title: Pace start (points)
paceStart.description: How many points of the 5-hour and 7-day limits you may be ahead of the clock before the bar turns amber with a ▲ (up to it, there is no mark). 0 flags any lead; 5 ignores a lead of up to 5 points. Red still starts beyond 15 points ahead, or at 90% used.
